Is it possible to obtain a medical certificate for back pain online?

Yes. DrCertificate connects people with back pain to certified MBBS, MD or MS doctors, who may issue a medical certificate after a digital chat consultation. Issuing is the doctor's decision. Approved certificates arrive as a PDF by email. The service covers non emergency cases only and is not for India, legal matters or insurance.
Before you apply
What is a medical certificate for back pain?

A medical certificate for back pain is a signed PDF note from a certified doctor confirming that you consulted them about back pain and, in their judgement, need rest or a change to how you work for a stated period. Employers and universities usually ask for one to support an absence.
Most people with back pain choose the sick leave option. The work from home option suits someone who can manage a laptop at home but not a commute or a full day at an office desk.
The certificate records the doctor's decision after a chat consultation.
DrCertificate does not diagnose, treat or prescribe, so the certificate is not a treatment plan.
Which kinds of back pain can a doctor consider online?
A doctor on DrCertificate can consider common, non emergency back pain during a chat consultation. The presentations people describe most often are shown here.
The doctor decides whether any rest is needed and for how long, based on what you share. No type of back pain comes with a set number of days.

The NHS says back pain usually gets better within weeks, though it can last longer or keep coming back. Back pain that started after a serious accident, or that comes with the warning signs in the next section, is not suitable for chat and needs in person care.

items: Lower back strain Pain and stiffness in the lower back after lifting, twisting, bending or a long day of physical work.
Muscle spasm Sudden tightness in the back muscles that makes standing, sitting or turning painful.
Neck and upper back pain Stiffness across the neck, shoulders or upper back, often after long hours at a desk or screen.
Pain spreading into one leg Pain that travels from the lower back down one leg, sometimes called sciatica. Symptoms in both legs are a warning sign.

blocks.text: What should you tell the doctor about your back pain?
Tell the doctor where your back hurts, when the pain started and how bad it is. Clear details let the doctor make a decision without guessing.
Mention whether the pain spreads into a leg, what makes it worse, and how it affects sitting, standing or walking. Give the date it began and a severity score from 0 to 10.
If you already have an X-ray, MRI or clinic report, include the main findings.
State the leave dates you are asking for.

items: Location and spread Lower back, upper back or neck, and whether pain or tingling reaches one leg.
Onset and duration The date the pain began, what you were doing and whether it has happened before.
Severity and effect on work A score from 0 to 10 and which work tasks you cannot manage.

blocks.text: When is back pain not suitable for an online certificate?

Back pain is not suitable for an online certificate when it comes with signs of a serious problem. The NHS advises emergency care if back pain comes with any of the signs listed here, so go to an emergency department or call your local emergency number.
DrCertificate is only for suitable non emergency situations and does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. A doctor may decline a request that cannot be handled safely by chat.
Get help in person first.

items: Both legs affected Pain, tingling, weakness or numbness in both legs.
Loss of feeling Numbness around the genitals or anus.
Bladder or bowel changes Trouble passing urine, leaking, or changes in bowel control.
Chest pain Back pain that comes with chest pain.
After a serious accident Back pain that started after a fall, crash or other serious injury.

How much does a medical certificate for back pain cost?
A medical certificate for back pain costs 25 SGD in Singapore, 399 pesos in the Philippines and 30 MYR in Malaysia. The price depends on your country.
The fee pays for a certified doctor to review your request. You pay securely through Stripe.
Payments are non refundable, except for a verified technical fault reported within 24 hours.

What happens if the doctor does not issue a certificate for back pain?
If the doctor does not issue a certificate, you receive no certificate and the payment is not refunded. Issuing is always the independent doctor's decision.

Doctors decline about 2% of requests. The usual reasons are wrong details, a name that does not match the ID, or symptoms and details that do not add up. Back pain with warning signs is also not suitable for chat.
A certificate cannot be corrected once issued, unless the fault came from the medical team.
For questions, email care@drcertificate.com.

blocks.text: Questions about medical certificates for back pain
Can I share an X-ray or MRI report for my back pain?

Yes, include details from any X-ray, MRI or earlier clinic report when you describe your back pain. Reports give the doctor more context, but common back strain does not need one. The doctor decides whether the information you share is enough to issue a medical certificate for back pain.
How many days off can I get for back pain?

The doctor decides how many days, if any, after the chat consultation. In most South East Asian countries, sick leave and work from home notes go up to 7 days for generic symptoms. The NHS says back pain usually improves within weeks, so pain that lasts longer is worth checking in person.
Will my employer accept an online medical certificate for back pain?

Your employer or university decides whether to accept an online medical certificate. All doctors on DrCertificate are registered with a medical council, yet workplace policies differ. Check with HR or your school office that online medical notes are accepted before you apply, since payments are non refundable.
Can I speak to the doctor by video or visit in person?

No. DrCertificate does not offer video or in person consultations. Every request is handled through the online form and a digital chat with a certified doctor. If your back pain needs a physical examination, see a doctor at a local clinic or hospital instead of applying online.
What should I do if my back pain gets worse?

See a doctor in person if your back pain gets worse or does not improve. Go to an emergency department straight away if you notice weakness or numbness in both legs, numbness around the genitals or anus, bladder or bowel changes, or chest pain. An online certificate is not a substitute for care.
Can I get a fit to work certificate after back pain?

Yes. Fit to work requests use the Medical Fitness Certificate option on the form, and fitness notes are generally valid for 30 days. Doctors handle fitness cases from 9 am to 9 pm IST Monday to Saturday and from 10 am to 8 pm IST on Sunday.
